assumption-kind:general/procedure-validi.collapses: The named procedure's unknown validation domain or recorded scope gap is conditionally accepted for this target.
assumption-kind:general/procedure-validi.licenses: Recording record, co_scope and dimensions under the binding-aptness interface; the first consumer is the mm30 PHF19 gene-RNA assay with no established validation domain.
assumption-kind:general/procedure-validi.not_established: The assumption does not validate the procedure, supply empirical standing, establish independence or certify biological reuse.

design:general/independent-groups.collapses: Pairing and repeated measures are not modeled by this design declaration.
design:general/independent-groups.licenses: Naming the design actually used by the existing unpaired mm30 estimator.
design:general/independent-groups.not_established: Independence is not certified; the source cohort's pairing remains a limitation to disclose.

functional:general/probability-of-superi.collapses: The comparison summarizes distributions through relative ordering and half-weighted ties.
functional:general/probability-of-superi.licenses: The half-tie target of the mm30 midrank statistic under the complete property declaration in this design.
functional:general/probability-of-superi.not_established: A mean difference, causal effect, independent samples, valid uncertainty or a reported effect estimate is not established by a z statistic or p value.

identification-class:general/observation.collapses: The label alone does not encode a causal identification argument.
identification-class:general/observation.licenses: Statistical-layer targets in the mm30 analysis.

procedure-kind:general/assay.collapses: Instrument and processing particulars stay in the procedure record.
procedure-kind:general/assay.licenses: Classifying the mm30 RNA quantification procedure; fills_within_model is false.
procedure-kind:general/assay.not_established: The label alone establishes neither calibration, valid scope nor a model-specification role.

procedure-kind:general/estimator.collapses: Algorithm, parameters, implementation and input assumptions stay in the procedure record.
procedure-kind:general/estimator.licenses: Classifying the mm30 Mann–Whitney computation; fills_within_model is false.
procedure-kind:general/estimator.not_established: The kind does not prove correctness, identify a functional without its declaration, or supply empirical standing.

quantity-kind:general/relative-abundance.collapses: Component resolution, normalization and the reference total are retained by the observable and procedure rather than this common quantity label.
quantity-kind:general/relative-abundance.licenses: A dimensionless quantity kind for the mm30 RNA abundance procedure; it supersedes the provisional transcript-abundance name.
quantity-kind:general/relative-abundance.not_established: This is not any generic proportion: a probability, membership fraction or power fraction is not relative abundance merely because it is unitless. Equal labels do not make denominators, RNA and protein, or quantification pipelines equivalent.

selection-mechanism:general/cohort-enrol.collapses: Recruitment and inclusion particulars stay in the analysis and procedure records.
selection-mechanism:general/cohort-enrol.licenses: Naming the sampling mechanism for the mm30 cohort analysis.
selection-mechanism:general/cohort-enrol.not_established: Random sampling, representativeness and absence of selection bias are not established.

template:general/changes-under-intervent.collapses: The relation abstracts over interventions and mechanisms; the estimand and procedures retain the particular intervention and response.
template:general/changes-under-intervent.licenses: A directed causal question and the target of a narrower literature bridge; first use is the biology successor's regulates bridge in architecture section 10.2.
template:general/changes-under-intervent.not_established: Observational association or a literature label alone does not establish intervention validity, mechanism or empirical support.

template:general/covaries-with.collapses: A shared relation groups many possible measures and conditioning schemes; the estimand fixes each one.
template:general/covaries-with.licenses: A symmetric statistical question; first use is the biology/mm30 analysis specified in the accepted measurement design section 12.
template:general/covaries-with.not_established: Causation, mechanism, exchangeability and interchangeability of measurements are not established.

transformation:general/identity.collapses: No transformation is applied; upstream preprocessing remains part of the procedure.
transformation:general/identity.licenses: The untransformed numerical response consumed by mm30's rank analysis.
transformation:general/identity.not_established: Raw values are not thereby unprocessed observations or comparable across procedures.
